overrides.title: Flowgen
overrides.problem: AI-powered content workflow management platform for creators.

overrides.title: PATH RL
overrides.problem: Autonomous reinforcement learning framework for dynamic obstacle avoidance and navigation.
overrides.approach: Engineered modular policy gradient and Q-learning path planning algorithms in Python.
overrides.outcome: Achieved efficient convergence and optimal trajectory planning across simulation benchmarks.

overrides.title: LUNAR
overrides.problem: Autonomous spacecraft lunar landing guidance and thrust vector control simulation.
overrides.approach: Engineered physics-based numerical trajectory simulation in Python with feedback control.
overrides.outcome: Demonstrated stable soft-landing descent trajectories with high accuracy under low gravity.

overrides.title: Circle to Search
overrides.problem: Visual gesture-based search system and interactive bounding detector.
overrides.approach: Engineered real-time gesture recognition and canvas bounding pipeline in JavaScript.
overrides.outcome: Delivered intuitive visual search interaction with zero perceptible input lag.

overrides.title: Plane Plant UML Integration
overrides.problem: Automated architectural UML diagram generation and code analysis pipeline.
overrides.approach: Engineered modular analysis pipeline in Python parsing code structures to PlantUML.
overrides.outcome: Automated diagram generation reducing architectural documentation overhead and visual drift.
